method: 324 GPU-finish plus one-pixel-readback renders,960×640 DPR1. Three profiles×three scenes×M14 merged/15C/15D×three alternating rounds×four samples. Warmup, exact camera/solar/wind/date and common weather fields asserted identical. No other browser or GPU work. Clear summer conditions common to all versions; M14 has no snow mode. Software SwiftShader, not hardware or Android FPS. Native-loop stalls measured separately during the real thirty-minute production walk.
